params.prompt: Cinematic miniature diorama, heroic armored-tech workshop aesthetic: glossy hot-rod red and gold metal plating with crisp panel lines and rivets, brushed gunmetal accents, warm tungsten garage lighting, subtle cool reactor-glow highlights, tilt-shift miniature photography look, isometric three-quarter aerial view, ultra detailed, empty, unoccupied, no people, architectural model quality. On a plain solid deep warm charcoal background with a soft contact shadow. Palette: hot-rod red #B91C1C, gold #D4A017, gunmetal #3F3F46, amber core glow, warm white #FAF7F0. No text, no letters, no logos, centered composition. IMPORTANT: any armor design must be an entirely original invented design, NOT resembling Iron Man or any Marvel or famous superhero. Subject: a logistics hangar bay — rows of docked faceless armored cargo drones in red and gunmetal with a single amber sensor bar instead of a face, stacked shipping crates and parcels moving on conveyor belts, an overhead loading gantry crane, huge hangar doors half open with warm light spilling in.
